title: Concord Test Package Manifest v1.0
description: Defines the structure of concord.yaml for validation and manufacturing test packages.

schema.description: Manifest schema version. Must match exactly.

type.description: Package type. Determines whether 'stages' or 'steps' is expected.

slug.description: Product slug matching the Concord product record.

design.description: Fixture design name matching the 'name' field in fixture.yaml (e.g., 'Alpha B0 Manufacturing Fixture').

revision.description: Fixture hardware revision matching the 'revision' field in fixture.yaml (e.g., '1.0', '1.2').

controller.description: Dotted Python import path to the fixture controller class (e.g., 'fixtures.alpha_b0.controller.AlphaB0Fixture').

profile.description: Relative path to the fixture YAML profile (e.g., 'fixtures/alpha_b0/fixture.yaml').

multi_slot.description: Whether the fixture supports multiple DUT slots. Enables panel/batch workflow.

stages.description: Test stages. Each key is a stage name. Validation packages and stage-style manufacturing packages.

steps.description: Manufacturing test steps in sequential order. Alternative to 'stages' for manufacturing packages.

directory.description: Relative path to the test directory for this stage (e.g., 'tests/smoke').

module.description: Python module name within the directory (e.g., 'test_01_electrical'). For manufacturing stages.

timeout_s.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for this stage.

enabled.description: Whether this stage is enabled. Disabled stages are skipped.

markers.description: Pytest markers registered for this stage (e.g., ['health_check', 'fuota_fast']).

name.description: Display name for the manufacturing step (e.g., 'Electrical', 'Flash Firmware').

module.description: Dotted Python module path containing the step (e.g., 'tests.manufacturing.test_electrical').

timeout_s.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for this step.
